_comment: Manifest for the managed DATA assets — files the add-in fetches at runtime instead of shipping
them inside the installer. Mirrors icons_map.json in role, but keeps its own version line so a
data fix never forces an icon re-check.
Publish this file to {githubRaw}/Xadd-in/json/assets_map.json and the files themselves under
Version  — bump on ANY change below. The client compares this one string and skips everything
when it matches, so a no-change startup costs a single small request.
Key      — the stable name a consumer asks for. NEVER put a version in it: the whole point is
that countriesV4 -> countriesV5 is an edit to FileName here, touching no code.
FileName — path under both the assets root on disk and the remote base.

Assets.Description: Country reference dataset — ISO codes, names, currencies, dialling codes.
